description: Shared vectors for CONTRACT.md, The request file and pasted blocks. vectors: a request text with its h, hash link, file name and blocks (absent over 10 blocks). pastes: the texts a person pastes into the page, one paste per entry, against vectors[vector]; the page rebuilds text, or ends with error INCOMPLETE (not every block yet) or MISMATCH (the joined pieces fail the h check); refused lists the pastes the page refuses a block of (another h, another count, or a piece before the last shorter than 1800; a paste with no header is refused too). files: a file's content against vectors[vector]; the page reads text from it after removing a leading U+FEFF and White_Space, or ends with MISMATCH.
